title: Charina Carmen pulls out of 'Stars Reignited' concert over alleged unfair treatment
summary: Beauty queen-actress Charina Carmen announced her withdrawal from the “Stars Reignited” concert, citing alleged unprofessionalism and unfair treatment by the event organizers.…

blocks.text: Beauty queen-actress Charina Carmen announced her withdrawal from the “Stars Reignited” concert, citing alleged unprofessionalism and unfair treatment by the event organizers. Carmen’s camp said her name was omitted from the concert’s official billing and publicity materials despite prior discussions and an agreement regarding her participation in the event. “The way you treated my talent was unfair,” said Carmen’s talent manager Richard Hinola. “You secured her participation, asked her to help sell tickets, which required extra effort on her part, and the ₱30,000 payment had already been settled.
